paragraphs.source_en:
Which Agave lifted up
475 In the weird Cadmæan forest.
 Brother, wheresoe’er thou soarest
I must hurry, whirl and follow
Through the heavens wide and hollow,
Sheltered by the warm embrace
480 Of thy soul from hungry space,
Drinking from thy sense and sight
Beauty, majesty, and might,
As a lover or chameleon
Grows like what it looks upon,
485 As a violet’s gentle eye
Gazes on the azure sky
Until its hue grows like what it beholds,
As a grey and watery mist
Glows like solid amethyst
490 Athwart the western mountain it enfolds
When the sunset sleeps
Upon its snow —

paragraphs.source_en:
The Earth
And the weak day weeps
That it should be so.
 495 O gentle Moon, the voice of thy delight
Falls on me like thy clear and tender light
Soothing the seaman, borne the summer night
Through isles forever calm;
O gentle Moon, thy crystal accents pierce
